sources.snippet: The key difference from previous Gemma releases for vision is the new design to process images of different sizes using a fixed-budget number of tokens. Unlike many models that squash every image into a fixed square (like 224×224), Gemma 4 keeps the image's natural aspect ratio while making it the right size.
